look_here_first: Check the stem before the fruit: branchlets are uniformly red to purplish-red or chestnut, while leaves are usually deeply 3–5-lobed with long-pointed lobes and nearly glabrous undersides.

key_traits.label: Field character
key_traits.text: branchlets uniformly red, purplish-red, or chestnut

key_traits.label: Field character
key_traits.text: branchlets glabrous or only sparsely cobwebby

key_traits.label: Field character
key_traits.text: leaves usually deeply 3–5-lobed with long-acuminate tips

key_traits.label: Field character
key_traits.text: leaf undersides glabrous or nearly so

key_traits.label: Field character
key_traits.text: berries blue-black to black, roughly 8–10 mm

key_traits.label: Field character
key_traits.text: riverbank, slough, and alluvial floodplain habitat

lookalikes.differences: Uniform red branchlets + deeply lobed leaves + glabrous lower surface are the fastest field combination.
